measurement-label.purpose: Exact logical-point dimensions and active aspect ratio inside the control capsule.

capsule-icon.purpose: Native move, border, disclosure, and quit actions.

motion.name: immediate
motion.purpose: Native full-area dragging, ratio-preserving corner resizing, and state changes use no decorative animation.

components.name: Guide Perimeter
components.description: Transparent aperture at the selected ratio with an outside two-point boundary, an in-frame control capsule, exactly four corner handles, and a full-area move surface. Show or Hide Frame orders this complete overlay out or in without changing its retained geometry; persisted border visibility affects only the perimeter and handles.

components.name: Control Capsule
components.description: Compact native-material cluster for movement feedback, border visibility, exact size and ratio selection, and Quit.
components.css: .ds-capsule { height: 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 18%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; color: CanvasText; background: color-mix(in srgb, Canvas 72%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-capsule-move { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.2; } .ds-capsule-icon, .ds-capsule-size { height: 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-capsule-icon { width: 16px; } .ds-capsule-icon svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-capsule-size { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font: 500 12px 'SF Pro Rounded', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-capsule-size svg { width: 8px; height: 5px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-capsule-icon:hover, .ds-capsule-size:hover { color: rgb(10% 48% 100%); } .ds-capsule-icon:focus-visible, .ds-capsule-size:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid CanvasText; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Corner Handle
components.description: One of exactly four corner resize affordances; dragging preserves the active ratio with the opposite corner anchored.
components.css: .ds-corner-handle { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, black 40%, transparent); border-radius: 1.5px; background: rgb(10% 48% 100%); cursor: nwse-resize; } .ds-corner-handle:hover { border-color: black; } .ds-corner-handle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid CanvasText; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
SlideFrame is a restrained native measuring instrument, not an application window laid over the desktop. It runs as an `LSUIElement` utility whose `rectangle.inset.filled` menu-bar status item is the persistent application surface. Its transparent field leaves the user's work visually untouched while one exact perimeter, one compact in-frame control capsule, and four quiet corner handles communicate the complete overlay state.

The system is sparse, direct, and geometrically trustworthy. It uses macOS-native material, menus, cursors, SF Symbols, and system type rather than decorative chrome. Multiple output ratios are first-class, but the overlay keeps one consistent visual vocabulary across them.
keyCharacteristics: A transparent aperture at the selected ratio is the dominant form.
Presentation blue is the default working signal; white, black, and red are contrast alternatives.
Four exact 16:9 presets coexist with 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 9:16, 3:4, and current-display ratio modes.
Native full-area dragging uses open- and closed-hand cursor feedback while capsule controls and corner handles retain interaction priority.
The in-frame capsule reports dimensions and aspect ratio and exposes frequent border, size, and quit actions.
The menu-bar status item remains the complete native control surface when the overlay is hidden or click-through is enabled.

rules.name: The Boundary-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Working colors identify the measured perimeter and handles; they do not decorate menus or create branded surfaces.

rules.name: The Functional Alternatives Rule
rules.body: White, black, and red are user-selected contrast tools, never a simultaneous palette.

rules.name: The Measurement Type Rule
rules.body: Dimensions and ratio use SF Pro Rounded medium with tabular numerals; command text and symbols stay at native macOS defaults.

rules.name: The Inner-Boundary Rule
rules.body: Preset dimensions describe the transparent inner aperture; the two-point guide stroke sits outside it and must never reduce the captured area.

rules.name: The Selected-Ratio Rule
rules.body: Fit, restore, and corner resize preserve the active ratio; only the four exact presets force 16:9.

rules.name: The Direct-Manipulation Rule
rules.body: The full clear panel moves natively with open- and closed-hand feedback; capsule controls and corner handles remain above that move surface.

rules.name: The No-Window-Chrome Rule
rules.body: The guide has no opaque panel surface, title bar, window shadow, or decorative elevation.

dos: Do keep the desktop and framed content fully transparent and visually untouched.
Do preserve the selected ratio during fit, restore, and exact opposite-corner resizing.
Do keep all four exact presets at 16:9 while exposing the five named ratios and current-display ratio.
Do use full-area native dragging with open- and closed-hand feedback.
Do keep dimensions, aspect ratio, border visibility, size choices, and quit available in the compact in-frame capsule.
Do allow the boundary-hidden capsule-only state and hide capsule plus handles during click-through.
Do rely on native macOS menus, materials, system colors, typography, symbols, and cursor behavior.
Do keep `LSUIElement`, the SlideFrame menu-bar status item, and its native menu as the complete application shell.
donts: Don't add dashboard chrome, inspectors, floating toolbars, title bars, or opaque framing surfaces.
Don't place the perimeter stroke inside the aperture.
Don't add side or midpoint resize handles; the four corners are the complete resize vocabulary.
Don't restrict movement to border strips or make the transparent aperture feel inert.
Don't hide the capsule merely because the boundary is hidden.
Don't add window shadows or decorative animation; state changes are immediate.
Don't replace native menu affordances or system typography with web-shaped controls or display faces.
Don't introduce an additional application-launcher surface or ordinary app-window lifecycle.
